definitions.explanation: The time at twelve hours past midnight or noon. Noon or midnight.

examples.japanese: {十二時|じゅうにじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{昼|ひる}ごはん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I eat lunch at twelve o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{十二時|じゅうにじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I go to bed at twelve o'clock every day.
Let's meet at the station at noon.

notes:
{十二時|じゅうにじ} can refer to either noon or midnight. Without context, it is ambiguous, so speakers often add a clarifying word.

CLARIFYING EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十二時|じゅうにじ}: noon (12:00 PM)
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十二時|じゅうにじ}: midnight (12:00 AM)
- ⟦{正午|しょうご}→正午：03231_shougo⟧: noon (formal, unambiguous)
- ⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧: midnight (unambiguous)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {十二時半|じゅうにじはん}: 12:30
- {十二時|じゅうにじ}⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧: exactly twelve o'clock
- {十二時|じゅうにじ}{過|す}ぎ: past twelve

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, ⟦{昼休|ひるやす}み→昼休み：01715_hiruyasumi⟧ (lunch break) typically starts at noon, so {十二時|じゅうにじ} without qualification often implies lunchtime in workplace and school contexts.
